These query/validation techniques derive from megadose/Holehe (megadose and module contributors), GPL-3.0.

Pinned upstream commit: `14da70f588538936b20d238783c5e28a0772a2b3`.
See provenance.json for source paths and SHA-256 checksums.

Person Map changes: bounded asyncio execution; strict parsers; per-service HTTP diagnostics; same-domain negative controls; shared HTTP budgets; isolated CSRF/cookie contexts; removal of signup submission, recovery dispatch, and duplicate Google/Gravatar checks.
No claim is made that all upstream modules currently work.
